::: {.callout-warning}
## Submit an abstract

Abstract submissions are included in the 2027 registration form. Submission
deadlines, eligibility, and abstract requirements have not yet been posted.

[Open the registration and abstract form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1dtzYnySbiBodRr7eGd7j7YmSnmkKvqxb0JqRscCwvnA/edit){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}
:::

## Submission information

The 2027 meeting uses the registration form for abstract submission. Current
instructions and deadlines will be added here when they are available.

Once the current program is released, presenters should check the
[Schedule](schedule.qmd) for their assigned time or poster session. Accepted
presenters can find format and preparation guidance on [For Presenters](for-presenters.qmd).
Questions about submissions can be sent through [Contact Us](../contact.qmd).

*[Source: 2027 registration and abstract submission information](https://socalboom.wordpress.com/home/registration-and-abstract-submission/).*
